terminal.description: A shell that starts in the shop's top folder. List what you are about to remove before you remove it.

tasks.title: Remove the duplicate fox poster
tasks.description:
`artwork` holds the fox poster twice: `fox-poster.svg` and an exact copy called `fox-poster copy.svg`. Remove the copy. `fox-poster.svg` stays.

Check looks for `fox-poster.svg` unchanged in `artwork` and no `fox-poster copy.svg` beside it.
nextSteps: Run `ls artwork` and find both posters.
Look at the copy's name: it has a space in it.
Remove only the copy, keeping its name together.
Run `ls artwork` again: `fox-poster.svg` is still there.
hints: The copy's name has a space, so it needs the same care as a folder name with a space.
`rm` with the name in quotes, or with a backslash before the space, removes exactly that file. A pattern like `fox-poster*` would catch the original too.
Run `rm "artwork/fox-poster copy.svg"` from the top folder.

tasks.title: Clear the temporary files
tasks.description:
Sol's handover note says the print driver fills `downloads` with `.tmp` files that are safe to delete. Remove every `.tmp` file in `downloads`. Every other file there stays.

Check looks for any `.tmp` file left in `downloads`, and fails if another file in `downloads` is gone.
nextSteps: Run `ls downloads` and see which files end in `.tmp`.
Write a pattern for them and check it with `ls` first.
Remove them with the same pattern.
List `downloads` again: only the other files remain.
hints: A pattern from the last issue picks out files by their ending.
`ls downloads/*.tmp` should list only the temporary files. Hand the same pattern to `rm`.
Run `rm downloads/*.tmp` from the top folder.

tasks.title: Rescue the logo
tasks.description:
The old web site in `old-site` is going, but Sol says to keep the logo. Get `old-site/logo.svg` into `artwork`, keeping the name `logo.svg`. Do this before the next task, because what `rm` removes does not come back.

Check looks for `artwork/logo.svg` with the logo's contents.
nextSteps: Run `ls old-site` and find the logo.
Move it into `artwork` with a command from an earlier issue.
hints: Nothing new here: you moved files into folders two issues ago.
`mv` takes the logo's path first and `artwork` last.
Run `mv old-site/logo.svg artwork` from the top folder.

tasks.title: Remove the old site
tasks.description:
Once the logo is safe, remove the folder `old-site` with everything still in it, the `images` folder included.

Check passes when `old-site` is gone from the top folder and none of its files is left anywhere else in the workspace.
nextSteps: Check the previous task is done: the logo is in `artwork`.
Run `ls old-site` to see what is about to go.
Remove the whole folder in one command.
Run `ls` in the top folder: `old-site` is no longer there.
hints: `rmdir` refuses a folder that still holds files, and plain `rm` refuses any folder.
`rm -r` removes a folder with everything inside it. Type the folder's name carefully.
Run `rm -r old-site` from the top folder.
